from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path.cwd()
EVIDENCE = ROOT / "work/ceres-v3/05/evidence/controlled-20261005T213814Z-e9eee78c"
COLLECT = EVIDENCE / "collect/collection.json"
INTAKE = EVIDENCE / "baseline-intake.json"
PLAN = ROOT / "work/ceres-v3/05/coverage-plan.json"
CASES = ROOT / "evals/v3/core-cases.json"
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
PYTHON = BACKEND / ".venv/Scripts/python.exe"
DB = ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db"


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def write_json(path: Path, value: object) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def git_head() -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()


def current_source_hashes(records: list[dict]) -> dict[str, str]:
    return {entry["path"]: sha256(ROOT / entry["path"]) for entry in records}


intake = json.loads(INTAKE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
collection = json.loads(COLLECT.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
plan = json.loads(PLAN.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
case_doc = json.loads(CASES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
source_records = intake["current_worktree_checks"]
if intake["git_head_actual"] != "5462e999d583a9bab6147d0b4141d98321f3cc92":
    raise SystemExit("baseline intake HEAD does not match authorized fixed point")
if git_head() != intake["git_head_actual"]:
    raise SystemExit("current HEAD changed since baseline intake")
if not intake["current_all_source_hashes_match"] or len(source_records) != 304:
    raise SystemExit("baseline intake source hashes/count are not clean")
before = current_source_hashes(source_records)
for record in source_records:
    if before[record["path"]] != record["expected_sha256"]:
        raise SystemExit(f"source hash changed before test: {record['path']}")
if sha256(DB) != intake["source_catalog"]["sha256_expected"]:
    raise SystemExit("source catalog hash differs from frozen baseline")

all_nodes = collection["collected_nodes"]


def resolve_case_node(case_id: str, source_path: str) -> list[str]:
    relative = source_path.removeprefix("backend/")
    function = relative.split("::", 1)[1]
    prefix = f"{relative.split('::', 1)[0]}::"
    found = [node for node in all_nodes if node.startswith(prefix + function)]
    if case_id == "R01":
        found = [node for node in found if "[keke-" in node]
    elif case_id == "R08":
        found = [node for node in found if "[momo-" in node]
    elif case_id == "R02":
        found = [node for node in found if "[R02-" in node]
    elif case_id == "P01":
        found = [node for node in found if "[P01-" in node]
    if not found:
        raise SystemExit(f"no actual collected parameter node for {case_id}: {source_path}")
    return found


case_by_id = {case["id"]: case for case in case_doc["cases"]}
case_mapping: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
for case_id, targets in plan["mapping"].items():
    nodes: list[str] = []
    for target in targets:
        nodes.extend(resolve_case_node(case_id, target))
    case_mapping[case_id] = list(dict.fromkeys(nodes))
unique_nodes = list(dict.fromkeys(node for case_id in plan["mapping"] for node in case_mapping[case_id]))
if len(case_doc["cases"]) != 18 or len(unique_nodes) != 16:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected frozen coverage dimensions: cases={len(case_doc['cases'])} nodes={len(unique_nodes)}")

case_assertions: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
for node in unique_nodes:
    rel_path, function = node.split("::", 1)
    function = function.split("[", 1)[0]
    source_path = BACKEND / rel_path
    tree = ast.parse(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    source_lines = source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    function_node = next(item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and item.name == function)
    assertions = [
        {"line": item.lineno, "source": source_lines[item.lineno - 1].strip()}
        for item in ast.walk(function_node)
        if isinstance(item, ast.Assert)
    ]
    case_assertions[node] = sorted(assertions, key=lambda item: item["line"])

run_dir = EVIDENCE / "core-001"
if run_dir.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"execution evidence directory already exists; refusing overwrite: {run_dir}")
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
for name in ("os-temp", "stdout", "stderr"):
    (run_dir / name).mkdir()

plugin_path = run_dir / "ceres_controlled_trace.py"
plugin = r'''import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

TRACE = Path(os.environ["CERES_TRACE_PATH"])
CURRENT_NODE = None


def append(record):
    with TRACE.open("a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")


def pytest_collection_modifyitems(session, config, items):
    for item in items:
        module = item.module
        original = getattr(module, "events", None)
        if not callable(original) or getattr(original, "_ceres_trace_wrapper", False):
            continue

        def traced_events(response, _original=original):
            events = _original(response)
            append({"kind": "sse_events", "nodeid": CURRENT_NODE, "events": events})
            return events

        traced_events._ceres_trace_wrapper = True
        module.events = traced_events


def pytest_runtest_setup(item):
    global CURRENT_NODE
    CURRENT_NODE = item.nodeid
    append({"kind": "test_start", "nodeid": item.nodeid})


@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
def pytest_runtest_makereport(item, call):
    outcome = yield
    report = outcome.get_result()
    if report.when != "call":
        return
    params = getattr(getattr(item, "callspec", None), "params", {})
    safe_fixtures = {}
    if "kev" in getattr(item, "funcargs", {}):
        safe_fixtures["kev_choices"] = item.funcargs["kev"]
    append({
        "kind": "test_result",
        "nodeid": item.nodeid,
        "outcome": report.outcome,
        "duration_seconds": report.duration,
        "parameters": params,
        "safe_fixture_state": safe_fixtures,
        "failure": str(report.longrepr) if report.failed else None,
        "captured_sections": report.sections,
    })


@pytest.hookimpl(hookwrapper=True)
def pytest_runtest_teardown(item, nextitem):
    global CURRENT_NODE
    yield
    CURRENT_NODE = None
'''
plugin_path.write_text(plugin, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

env = os.environ.copy()
removed_names = []
for key in list(env):
    upper = key.upper()
    if (
        re.search(r"(^|_)(API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|CREDENTIALS?)($|_)", upper)
        or upper.startswith(("OPENAI_", "ANTHROPIC_", "AZURE_", "GEMINI_", "DEEPSEEK_", "DASHSCOPE_", "QWEN_", "KEV_", "MEMORY_", "EMBEDDING_", "RETRIEVAL_", "MERCURY_", "LLM_"))
        or upper in {"DATABASE_URL", "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH", "TEMP", "TMP", "TMPDIR", "PYTHONPATH", "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY"}
    ):
        removed_names.append(key)
        del env[key]

controlled = {
    "LLM_MODE": "live",
    "BUSINESS_DATA_MODE": "demo",
    "OPENAI_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1",
    "OPENAI_API_KEY": "codex-test-key",
    "LLM_MODEL": "codex-test-model",
    "KEV_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9",
    "MEMORY_MODEL": "",
    "RETRIEVAL_MODE": "hybrid",
    "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR": "",
    "EMBEDDING_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1",
    "EMBEDDING_API_KEY": "codex-test-key",
    "EMBEDDING_MODEL": "codex-test-embedding",
    "EMBEDDING_REVISION": "controlled-baseline-v1",
    "EMBEDDING_DIMENSION": "1024",
    "MERCURY_DB_PATH": str(run_dir / "mercury.sqlite3"),
    "SOURCE_DATABASE_PATH": str(DB),
    "DATABASE_URL": f"sqlite:///{run_dir / 'unused-default.sqlite3'}",
    "TEMP": str(run_dir / "os-temp"),
    "TMP": str(run_dir / "os-temp"),
    "TMPDIR": str(run_dir / "os-temp"),
    "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
    "PYTHONUTF8": "1",
    "HTTP_PROXY": "",
    "HTTPS_PROXY": "",
    "ALL_PROXY": "",
    "NO_PROXY": "*",
    "CERES_TRACE_PATH": str(run_dir / "trace.jsonl"),
    "PYTHONPATH": str(run_dir),
}
env.update(controlled)

pytest_base = run_dir / "pytest-basetemp"
junit_path = run_dir / "junit.xml"
argv = [
    str(PYTHON), "-X", "utf8", "-m", "pytest", "-vv", "--showlocals",
    "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-W", "error::pytest.PytestUnhandledThreadExceptionWarning",
    "-p", "ceres_controlled_trace", f"--basetemp={pytest_base}", f"--junitxml={junit_path}",
    *unique_nodes,
]
command_path = run_dir / "command.txt"
command_path.write_text(subprocess.list2cmdline(argv) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
write_json(run_dir / "command.json", {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(BACKEND), "transport": "subprocess argv, no shell"})
write_json(run_dir / "environment.json", {
    "controlled_values": controlled,
    "removed_inherited_variable_names_only": sorted(removed_names),
    "actual_python_path": str(PYTHON),
    "python_version": platform.python_version(),
    "python_implementation": platform.python_implementation(),
    "pytest_version_from_verified_preflight": "9.1.1",
    "network_boundary": "provider/KEV URLs are loopback port 9; test fixtures replace controlled model/network boundaries; proxies cleared",
    "retrieval_contract": "RETRIEVAL_INDEX_DIR is empty; ordinary client uses direct DB; indexed_client creates lexical index paired to its per-test DB",
    "database_contract": "DATABASE_URL default and Mercury DB are run-local; pytest client/indexed_client fixtures override DATABASE_URL with their independent tmp_path DBs",
})

case_results = []
for case in case_doc["cases"]:
    case_id = case["id"]
    case_results.append({
        "case_id": case_id,
        "fixed_case_data": case,
        "actual_collected_execution_nodes": case_mapping[case_id],
        "assertion_source_lines": {node: case_assertions[node] for node in case_mapping[case_id]},
        "result": "pending",
    })
write_json(run_dir / "case-node-map.json", {
    "phase": "controlled characterization execution; not live model evaluation",
    "case_version": case_doc["version"],
    "case_count": len(case_results),
    "unique_actual_pytest_node_count": len(unique_nodes),
    "actual_collected_nodes": unique_nodes,
    "case_results": case_results,
})
write_json(run_dir / "source-before.json", {
    "git_head": git_head(),
    "manifest_path_count": len(before),
    "source_hashes": before,
    "all_match_frozen_baseline": True,
    "source_catalog_sha256": sha256(DB),
    "catalog_wal_size_bytes": (ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db-wal").stat().st_size if (ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db-wal").exists() else None,
    "trace_plugin_sha256": sha256(plugin_path),
})

write_json(run_dir / "run-start.json", {
    "started_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "run_id": run_dir.name,
    "selected_node_count": len(unique_nodes),
    "selected_case_count": len(case_results),
    "baseline_intake_path": str(INTAKE.relative_to(ROOT)),
    "collection_path": str(COLLECT.relative_to(ROOT)),
})
start = time.monotonic()
with (run_dir / "stdout.txt").open("wb") as stdout, (run_dir / "stderr.txt").open("wb") as stderr:
    completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=BACKEND, env=env, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, check=False)
elapsed = time.monotonic() - start

source_after = current_source_hashes(source_records)
source_stable = source_after == before
try:
    root = ET.parse(junit_path).getroot()
    junit_cases = []
    for element in root.iter("testcase"):
        outcome = "passed"
        failure = None
        for child in element:
            if child.tag in {"failure", "error"}:
                outcome = child.tag
                failure = {"message": child.attrib.get("message"), "text": child.text}
            elif child.tag == "skipped":
                outcome = "skipped"
        junit_cases.append({
            "classname": element.attrib.get("classname"),
            "name": element.attrib.get("name"),
            "duration_seconds": float(element.attrib.get("time", "0")),
            "outcome": outcome,
            "failure": failure,
        })
except Exception as exc:
    junit_cases = []
    junit_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
else:
    junit_error = None

node_status = {}
for entry in junit_cases:
    key = f"{entry['classname']}::{entry['name']}"
    node_status[key] = entry["outcome"]
trace_path = run_dir / "trace.jsonl"
trace_records = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if trace_path.exists() else []
for case_result in case_results:
    outcomes = []
    for node in case_result["actual_collected_execution_nodes"]:
        match = next((entry for entry in trace_records if entry.get("kind") == "test_result" and entry.get("nodeid") == node), None)
        if match:
            outcomes.append(match["outcome"])
        else:
            outcomes.append(node_status.get(node, "not-reported"))
    case_result["actual_node_outcomes"] = outcomes
    case_result["result"] = "pass" if outcomes and all(outcome == "passed" for outcome in outcomes) else ("fail" if any(outcome in {"failed", "failure", "error"} for outcome in outcomes) else "incomplete")

write_json(run_dir / "case-node-map.json", {
    "phase": "controlled characterization execution; not live model evaluation",
    "case_version": case_doc["version"],
    "case_count": len(case_results),
    "unique_actual_pytest_node_count": len(unique_nodes),
    "actual_collected_nodes": unique_nodes,
    "case_results": case_results,
})
write_json(run_dir / "junit-summary.json", {"cases": junit_cases, "parse_error": junit_error})
write_json(run_dir / "source-after.json", {
    "git_head": git_head(),
    "manifest_path_count": len(source_after),
    "source_hashes": source_after,
    "all_match_pre_execution": source_stable,
    "all_match_frozen_baseline": all(source_after[entry["path"]] == entry["expected_sha256"] for entry in source_records),
    "source_catalog_sha256": sha256(DB),
    "catalog_wal_size_bytes": (ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db-wal").stat().st_size if (ROOT / "data/sale_guide.db-wal").exists() else None,
})
stdout_path = run_dir / "stdout.txt"
stderr_path = run_dir / "stderr.txt"
write_json(run_dir / "result.json", {
    "completed_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "exit_code": completed.returncode,
    "duration_seconds": elapsed,
    "pytest_case_count": len(junit_cases),
    "pytest_outcomes": {key: sum(1 for row in junit_cases if row["outcome"] == key) for key in ("passed", "failure", "error", "skipped")},
    "case_results": {row["case_id"]: row["result"] for row in case_results},
    "source_hashes_unchanged": source_stable,
    "source_database_sha256_unchanged": sha256(DB) == intake["source_catalog"]["sha256_expected"],
    "stdout_sha256": sha256(stdout_path),
    "stderr_sha256": sha256(stderr_path),
    "trace_record_count": len(trace_records),
    "sse_trace_record_count": sum(1 for row in trace_records if row.get("kind") == "sse_events"),
    "junit_path": str(junit_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
    "raw_evidence_dir": str(run_dir.relative_to(ROOT)),
})
print(json.dumps({
    "evidence_dir": str(run_dir),
    "exit_code": completed.returncode,
    "duration_seconds": round(elapsed, 2),
    "pytest_case_count": len(junit_cases),
    "case_results": {row["case_id"]: row["result"] for row in case_results},
    "source_hashes_unchanged": source_stable,
    "stdout_sha256": sha256(stdout_path),
    "stderr_sha256": sha256(stderr_path),
}, ensure_ascii=False))
sys.exit(0)
